text:
Alex: Hey folks — handing off oncall in ~28m. Quick checklist I ran: VPN + SSH keys ok, pager access set for Priya, runbook for service-x updated with last deploy notes, credentials rotated for dev cluster. One thing: the token store path isn't documented in the runbook (I left a TODO). Will drop a note.

Priya: ack, I can take. Can you confirm I have pager test perms? I tried earlier but didn't get the test ping.

Alex: @Priya you should. I ran `pagerctl send --user priya --test` earlier and it returned 200. Could you try again now?

Priya: trying... nothing yet.

Alex: hmm. @oncall-bot pinged and said delivery failed earlier. @Chris did we change any pager routing rules in prod today?

Chris: No changes from me. There was a routing tweak in staging but not prod. @Alex can you paste the pagerctl output you saw?

Alex: Sure — output:
```
pagerctl send --user priya --test
status: 200
id: pgr_83bf
response: queued
```

Alex: Also double-check that your mobile number is verified in the portal — sometimes that's the blocker.

Priya: number verified. Re-running: same command shows queued but no notification.

Sam: quick guess — is the oncall rotation set to 'email-only' temporarily? I saw a deploy that toggled default channel to email.

Natalie: I updated rotation prefs last week to add sms fallback, but maybe the flag didn't propagate. @Chris can you check feature-flag 'pager-sms-fallback' in flags service?

Chris: checking... flag is on, last rollout 2h ago. Logs show one downstream error to twilio around 13:12 UTC. I'll open a ticket if it persists.

Alex: ok — @Priya if pager still silent when handoff starts, use the emergency manual page steps in the runbook: connect to bastion and run `scripts/manual_page.sh <incident>` — it's in the runbook under "Manual Paging". :warning:

Priya: noted. About VPN — Sam, any gotchas for remote access? I had issues with split-tunnel earlier.

Sam: Make sure the config is the 'oncall-profile' (not default). On Mac run:
```
sudo profiles install -type vpn oncall-profile.mobileconfig
open /Applications/LogMeInVPN.app
```
Also confirm `/etc/resolv.conf` has the redwood search domain.

Priya: thanks — I can test now.

oncall-bot: reminder: new oncall rotation starts at 16:00 UTC. Automated handoff message will post in 10m.

Alex: leaving a short handoff note in the pinned thread: 'watcher alert thresholds lowered for service-x, latency noise, retry policy set to 3 -> 2 for now. Will revert after weekend.' :white_check_mark:

Priya: got it, I'll keep an eye on the retry counts and escalate if noise persists.

Natalie: FYI I've added a small hint in the runbook about token store: /var/creds/service-x/. There's a short script `scripts/fetch_token.sh` that pulls from KMS, but it needs key access — @Alex can you confirm which team has the key permission?

Alex: Keys are granted to infra-service-accounts and to eng-oncall role. If you don't have it, file a short access request to security with the subject 'kms: service-x access' and tag me.

Priya: all set with VPN and I got a test page successfully. I'm ready to take over in 12m. Thanks!

Chris: I'll keep an eye on Twilio error and update here.

Alex: thanks all — handing off in 10m. Quick note: if you hit the manual page script, copy the output id into the ticket. Good luck.
